title: Provide a pixel-preserving contact-sheet utility for visual lanes
body: The lane's PIL-based contact-sheet command failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named PIL, and ffmpeg, magick, convert, montage, and rsvg-convert were unavailable. I had to write an ad hoc Python stdlib PNG decoder/compositor to assemble the reviewed sheet. Provide a shared pixel-preserving contact-sheet command so capture lanes do not each reimplement PNG handling.

title: Share complete reflected vector extraction across graph resources
body: Wiring the optional glm::vec3 module output exposed that PushConstantFieldSlotInfo copied the reflected base type and vector width but dropped componentType, while extraction keyed SPIR-V Vector instead of its scalar component. I had to preserve componentType through the field descriptor and normalize vectors in both the push-constant and ResourceExtractor paths. Consolidate on one reflected-type extraction contract so typed vecN values pack consistently.

title: Validate shader-cache interfaces before capture witnesses
body: The queued one-frame LVP capture for the updated SpatialReuseShade completed using the cached 96-byte push layout even though the source now declared a 112-byte layout. I had to rerun the same capture with VIXEN_SHADER_CACHE_DISABLE=1 to force fresh compilation; this produced the 112-byte reflection and valid module capture. Make the capture witness verify the compiled shader interface against current source, or invalidate stale interface entries automatically so the manual cache-bypass environment variable is unnecessary.
